meta.name: verify
meta.description: Drive an engine app headlessly in a pty, record a video of the whole verification, and open a summary page (video + timeline + checks) with pixel open.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动应用自动验证,录制全程视频并打开摘要页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要自动驱动应用运行并留下验证记录视频。
copy.tagline_en: Drive an app headlessly, record its verification, and open a summary page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate app verification and capture a video record

howto.what: Claude 会在伪终端里无头驱动引擎应用，发送按键、点击、滚轮等输入并推进帧，把整个验证过程录成视频，再生成含视频、可点击时间轴和检查表的汇总页，最后用 pixel open 打开。
howto.when: 当你要验证引擎应用的渲染或交互行为、希望留下可回放的验证记录时使用。它会写一个 driver 脚本，而不是只输出 PNG 的一次性脚本。

say.text: 帮我写个 driver 脚本验证滚轮滚动，并录下来
say.note: 产出脚本、视频和汇总页

say.text: 给这个验证加一条 check，确认滚动后画面重绘了
say.note: 检查结果会显示在汇总表里

howto.what_en: Claude drives your engine app headlessly in a pty, sends key, mouse, and wheel input, records the whole run as a video, then writes and opens a summary page with the video, timeline, and checks.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to verify an engine app's rendering or interaction behavior, or keep a replayable record of a verification run.

say_en.text: Write a driver script that verifies wheel scrolling and records it
say_en.note: Produces the script, video, and summary page

say_en.text: Run the tools/verify-recorder driver and open the result with pixel open
say_en.note: Opens the summary page with video and checks

say_en.text: Add a check that the screen redrew after scrolling
say_en.note: Check result appears in the summary table
